name: Karazhan
summary: In Deadwind Pass, Karazhan's sealed tower stirs with dangerous magic. Once Medivh's home, it rises above a meeting of ley lines that twists time, space, and reality. Restless spirits haunt its halls, and dangers remain within.

sections.title: The Guardian's Spire
sections.body:
Karazhan rises from ground shaped like a human skull, above a vast meeting of mystical ley lines. Built long before the First War, it was Medivh's refuge and storehouse for his magical secrets. The Last Guardian of Tirisfal lived in its winding halls with his castellan, Moroes. He welcomed noble guests and gathered arcane books and relics said to surpass even the libraries of the Kirin Tor.

Yet these walls witnessed Azeroth's greatest betrayal. Possessed by the demon Sargeras, Medivh secretly arranged the opening of the Dark Portal.

sections.title: A Haunted Threshold
sections.body:
Anduin Lothar and Medivh's apprentice, Khadgar, killed the Guardian, and Karazhan's gates were sealed. The tower fell into decay, but its powerful ley lines still twist reality. Ghostly echoes, illusions, and distortions of time ripple across Deadwind Pass.

Rumors say an evil presence stirs again inside the quiet fortress. Strange beings are drawn to its silhouette. Among them are the shadowy Dark Riders, who search the surrounding lands for forgotten relics.

faq.answer: No one knows Karazhan's origins, but the tower is known above all as the home of Medivh, the Last Guardian of Tirisfal. Built long before the First War, it rises in Deadwind Pass on skull shaped ground above a powerful meeting of ley lines.

faq.q: Who was Medivh, and why did he live here?
faq.answer: Medivh, son of Aegwynn, was the Last Guardian of Tirisfal, charged with defending Azeroth from demonic threats. He made Karazhan his home and sanctuary, filling it with arcane knowledge, servants such as Moroes, and lavish gatherings that hid his descent into madness.

faq.q: What happened to Medivh in the tower?
faq.answer: Since birth, Medivh had been possessed by the spirit of the Dark Titan Sargeras. Under that influence, he used the tower's magic to contact the warlock Gul'dan and open the Dark Portal. Khadgar, Lord Anduin Lothar, and the half-orc Garona uncovered his treachery. They entered Karazhan and killed the Guardian, ending his corruption.

faq.q: Can you enter Karazhan right now?
faq.answer: No. The tower's main gates and threshold remain sealed and warded against intruders. You can wander the abandoned village, crumbling church, and shadowy cellars beneath the surrounding grounds, but the spire itself is shut tight.

faq.q: Why is the area around Karazhan so corrupted and dead?
faq.answer: Karazhan sits above a vast meeting of ley lines, whose raw power twists the region around it. Along with the dark demonic sorcery Medivh unleashed inside, that power withered the surrounding canyon into the desolate wasteland called Deadwind Pass.

faq.q: Who are the Dark Riders connected to the tower?
faq.answer: The Dark Riders are a merciless band of relic hunters who haunt Duskwood and the lands around Deadwind Pass in search of powerful artifacts. Who they are and what binds them to the tower remain a mystery.

angles.text: As a mage, you can see Karazhan as a monument to the heights and perils of mortal sorcery. Its unmatched collection of artifacts and writings was kept from the Kirin Tor, while unstable ley lines threaten to consume any careless practitioner.

As an Alliance member, you know Karazhan holds tragic meaning for Stormwind. Medivh lived there; he was a boyhood friend of King Llane Wrynn and Anduin Lothar. His betrayal within those walls unleashed the First War upon humanity.
